### Granite Ridge Resources Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call


July 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/863234614/files/doc_news/Granite-Ridge-Resources-Schedules-Second-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Granite Ridge Resources, Inc. (“Granite Ridge” or the “Company”) (NYSE: GRNT) today announced that it will report its financial and operating results for the second quarter of 2026 on Thursday, August 6, 2026, after market close. The Company will host a webcast and conference call on Friday, August 7, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. central time to discuss its second quarter 2026 financial and operating results.


The details are as follows:


When:


Friday, August 7, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. CT


Where:


[https://ir.graniteridge.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.graniteridge.com&esheet=54565803&newsitemid=20260706275890&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.graniteridge.com&index=1&md5=f06438cb11566abae68832fc427cd1b9)


Webcast:


To access the live webcast, please click the[webcast link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2F69hoo3fd&esheet=54565803&newsitemid=20260706275890&lan=en-US&anchor=webcast+link&index=2&md5=01ee16dbec1d3be9bc5d511872b34bd6)


Dial-in / Q&A Participation:


1. Click on the[call link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregister-conf.media-server.com%2Fregister%2FBIf8e054299c744baf835ca1ba1747485f&esheet=54565803&newsitemid=20260706275890&lan=en-US&anchor=call+link&index=3&md5=f2463050155067440e495db24632dddb) and complete the online registration form.


2. Upon registering you will receive the dial-in info and a unique PIN to join the call as well as an email confirmation with the details.


3. Select method for joining the call:


a. **Dial-in:** A dial-in number and unique PIN will be displayed to connect directly from your phone.


b. **Call Me:** Enter your phone number and click “Call Me” for an immediate callback from the system. The call will come from a US number.


**About Granite Ridge**


Granite Ridge is a scaled energy company which aims to provide shareholders with exposure similar to energy private equity through operated partnerships and traditional non-operated assets. We own assets in six prolific unconventional basins across the United States. We aim to deliver a diversified portfolio with best-in-class full cycle returns by investing in a large number of high-graded deals developed by proven public and private operators. We focus on success as measured by total shareholder returns, which we seek to balance with a low leverage profile. Learn more at[www.graniteridge.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.graniteridge.com&esheet=54565803&newsitemid=20260706275890&lan=en-US&anchor=www.graniteridge.com&index=4&md5=86ed7867c75d088ba123aa28ed5c86c7) .
